summary: Tested 7 assertions (VAL-MILE-001 through VAL-MILE-007): all 7 passed. Ran 78 tests across 4 test files (milestone-plan-markers, milestone-tracker, state-milestone, plan-parser) with 180 expect() calls — all passing. Source code inspection confirms implementations match assertion descriptions: plan parser uses strict MILESTONE_RE regex, PlanPhase has optional milestone field with scope-based inheritance, MilestoneTracker excludes validation phases from completion checks and prevents re-injection via sealed milestone tracking, state file reader/writer round-trips milestone annotations correctly.
